actual_scope: Prove a disjoint-subset and rank-budget theorem for any finite number of binary scalar registers and any word length with at most two independent exponent relations and exact diagonal monomial endpoints.
scope_change_reason: The assigned fivecall restored-helper question was found already solved by merged CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#5481, and the finite4964 classification already existed in CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1846. The lead explicitly reassigned the task to the unresolved arbitrary-width two-relation question, using the inherited three-register theorem, a new analytic joint-image classification and an odd-core common-J generalization.
bottleneck_link: A rank-saving binary formal primitive now requires at least three independent rational frame relations. Eight-call 3x3 constructions at span six are excluded with any number of arbitrary diagonal auxiliaries; older results leave only span five. No new kappa or physical supplier follows.
stop_rule: Complete the universal written reduction and independent adversarial check, or preserve a precisely scoped gap. Bound controls to scalar widths2..5 and odd cores3,5,7; do not launch a raw ordered-word search or claim the rank-three relation case.
evidence: PROOF.md establishes the arbitrary-width theorem via the inherited #720 lemma. The analytic pool lemma gives image<=3 except disjoint-edge pools, and the common-J proof covers every odd core. verify.py independently replays4964 historical pools, checks108165 five-register planes,20097 prefix cases, exact endpoints and rejection controls.
